## Summary

Describe the mesh-management problem and the proposed change.

## Scope check

- [ ] The change supports geometry inspection, density management, optimization, selection,
      cropping, cleanup, validation, STL interchange, performance, or coordination.
- [ ] The change does not add general-purpose content-creation features.
- [ ] User-facing behavior and keyboard workflows were tested.
- [ ] No private meshes, scans, credentials, or identifying screenshots are included.

## Verification

List the files, mesh sizes, workflows, and release build used for verification. Use synthetic or
redistributable test data.
